summary:
Indian equity markets rallied strongly on November 25, 2026, with the Sensex surging over 1,500 points and Nifty 50 crossing 25,800.
The sharp market upside was driven by foreign fund inflows, lower crude oil prices, and gains recouping 2026 losses.
In corporate highlights, Wipro is adding 3,000 bp employees while Cabinet announced an ₹11,000 crore manufacturing scheme.
